identity: Six Dances by John C. Worley; catalog composer requires correction
findings: Kenneth Tse's official discography identifies Six Dances by John C. Worley on Lyric Soprano, Crystal CD658, with Alan Huckleberry, piano.
Frostburg State documents it in Justin Nines's 2010 senior saxophone recital. BYU-Idaho includes it in its college soprano curriculum.
Dorn edition DP991 is soprano saxophone and piano. Retailer track list names Prelude, Allemande, Sarabande, Gavotte, Courante and Gigue.
No evidence for the combined catalog name Pamela Tanious Worley was found.
